name: Grenade Launcher
summary: Single-shot break-action grenade launcher seen in GTA VI Trailer 2. Fires 40mm explosive rounds. Effective against armored vehicles and groups.
description: The Grenade Launcher is a break-action single-shot heavy weapon chambered for 40mm explosive rounds. Confirmed in GTA VI Trailer 2 footage, it delivers devastating area-of-effect damage capable of disabling armored vehicles in one hit and eliminating clustered enemies. Its 6-round reload capacity and wide blast radius make it the go-to choice for crowd control and vehicle takedowns.

seo.title: Grenade Launcher: Stats & Locations
seo.description: Complete profile of the Grenade Launcher in GTA VI. Blast radius, damage, reload speed, and locations to obtain this heavy explosive weapon in Leonida.
